cases.title: Results you can re-measure

items.title: Cutting operating costs of a manufacturing group
items.excerpt: Cost diagnostics across three plants, a new supplier strategy and controlling that keeps the savings after we leave.
items.body:
A group with three plants and 240 employees grew through acquisitions — and costs grew faster than revenue. Diagnostics revealed duplicated purchasing, unfavourable energy contracts and production overtime covering poor planning.

Within twelve months we unified purchasing under one negotiation, re-tendered energy and introduced an S&OP planning rhythm. Controlling now reports savings against the baseline every month — after a year, operating costs are down 23 % at the same production volume.

items.title: Cyber resilience of a fintech platform
items.excerpt: Security audit, business continuity plan and deployment automation for a platform with 180k users.
items.body:
A platform processing payments for 180k users grew faster than its infrastructure. Outages threatened both the licence and client trust. The audit revealed a single point of failure in the critical database and deployments with no fast rollback.

We introduced a redundant architecture, automated deployments with instant rollback and regular recovery testing. Critical systems availability rose to 99.98 % within six months and the regulatory audit passed without findings.

items.title: Stabilising the team of a logistics leader
items.excerpt: Competency model, performance-based pay and career paths for 850 employees in a three-shift operation.
items.body:
A logistics company with 850 employees was losing a third of its shift foremen and dispatchers every year — hiring couldn't keep up and operational quality fluctuated. Diagnostics showed that departures weren't driven by pay, but by unclear career paths and compensation detached from performance.

We built a competency model for key roles, tied rewards to measurable shift KPIs and opened internal career paths. Key-people attrition fell by 31 % in a year and onboarding time for a new foreman halved.

faq.title: What clients ask before working with us
faq.lead: Didn't find your answer? Book 30 minutes with a partner — the first consultation is free and without commitment.

items.question: How much does an engagement cost and how is it billed?
items.answer: We work with a fixed price per phase, not open-ended hourly billing. After diagnostics you receive a proposal with scope, price and a success metric — part of our fee can be tied to the achieved result.

items.question: How quickly will we see first results?
items.answer: Diagnostics takes ten working days and its output alone has value — a problem map with quantified impact. For cost projects, first measurable savings typically appear within three months.

items.question: How do you measure project success?
items.answer: Before we start, we agree on one main metric (e.g. operating costs, systems availability, attrition) and a baseline. Progress against the metric is reported monthly and the result is part of the handover.

items.question: How do you handle data confidentiality?
items.answer: Confidentiality is agreed contractually (NDA) before the first exchange of materials. We are ISO 27001 certified and process client data exclusively within the EU.

items.question: Who is the engagement a good fit for?
items.answer: Mid-sized and larger companies — typically from 50 employees or CZK 100m revenue — where a measurable result is worth more than the cost of a senior team. For smaller companies we recommend a one-off consultation.
